src: 8-connected monochrome foreground sprites s with equal bbox shape, ordered along the larger spread axis
dst: tightly packed output slots d in the same horizontal or vertical order
match_cond: rank(s left-to-right for horizontal layouts, or top-to-bottom for vertical layouts) == rank(d)
transform: crop each s to its bbox and paste the crops unchanged with all inter-sprite background spacing removed
grid_shape: one sprite bbox tall by N bbox widths for horizontal layouts, or N bbox heights by one sprite bbox wide for vertical layouts
